Strings.cleanerIntroCaption: Scans for caches, temporary files, crash dumps, leftovers from uninstalled apps and the Recycle Bin. You review everything first and removed items go to the Recycle Bin.
Strings.cleanerNothingFound: Nothing to clean. Your PC is tidy.
Strings.cleanerDoneNote: Items went to the Recycle Bin and can be restored from there.
Strings.cleanerAutoNotificationFormat: %@ freed and sent to the Recycle Bin.
Strings.cleanerScheduleCaption: Cleans only the safe part on its own at the chosen time and sends everything to the Recycle Bin. The app has to be running.
Strings.cleanerLoginItemsCaption: Startup entries whose program no longer exists.
Strings.cleanerLoginItemsNote: Each registry entry is saved to a backup file before it is removed.
Strings.cleanerLogsCaption: Crash dumps and Windows error reports nobody will send any more.
Strings.cleanerDeveloperCaption: Visual Studio and JetBrains caches that rebuild on their own.
Strings.cleanerCachesCaption: Temporary files, browser and graphics caches apps rebuild on their own.
Strings.cleanerLeftoversCaption: Data of apps you uninstalled: package folders, empty install folders and broken Start menu shortcuts.
Strings.cleanerOtherCachesCaption: Safe to remove, nothing breaks. Apps may open slower once, and downloaded content, like offline music or packages, downloads again.
Strings.cleanerTrashNote: Emptying the Recycle Bin is permanent.
Strings.cleanerDeviceBackupsCaption: iPhone and iPad backups made by iTunes or Apple Devices. Remove only the ones you no longer need; a new backup is made when you connect the device again.
Strings.cleanerScreenshotsCaptionFormat: Screenshots older than %d days that still have the name Windows gave them. Ones you renamed or moved never show up here. Windows does not record whether you opened them.
Strings.cleanerScreenshotsSettingCaption: The scan lists the screenshots that have not changed for this long, unchecked, with their total size.
Strings.uninstallerSomeFailed: Some items couldn’t be moved to the Recycle Bin.
whatsAppDownloads.intro: Finds files in Downloads that came from WhatsApp. File contents and chats are never read.
whatsAppDownloads.noFiles: No WhatsApp files found in Downloads.
whatsAppDownloads.trashNote: Files are moved to the Recycle Bin and remain recoverable until you empty it.
win.cleaner.windowsCleanupTitle: Windows Update and Delivery Optimization files
win.cleaner.windowsCleanupNote: Windows removes these itself, safely, under Settings › System › Storage › Temporary files.
win.cleaner.adminNote: The Windows temporary folder, system crash dumps and startup entries for all users need administrator rights.
win.cleaner.skippedRunningFormat: Not scanned while running: %@. Close them and scan again to include their caches.
win.cleaner.inUseFormat: %d items were in use by another app and were left in place.
win.cleaner.permanentlyDeletedFormat: %d items could not go to the Recycle Bin and were deleted permanently.
win.cleaner.backupNote: Removed startup entries were saved to a backup file. Double-click it to restore an entry.
win.cleaner.notificationsOff: Notifications are turned off for this app in Windows.
win.cleaner.whatsAppToggleCaption: Review WhatsApp files in Downloads. Nothing is removed automatically.
win.cleaner.whatsAppIntro: Files whose download record names WhatsApp are confirmed. Files that only carry WhatsApp’s file names are listed unticked: check them before ticking. Nothing is ever removed automatically.
win.cleaner.whatsAppNameOnlyHint: Only the file name suggests WhatsApp. Check the file before ticking it.
win.cleaner.whatsAppResultFormat: %1$d files (%2$@) moved to the Recycle Bin. %3$d failed.
win.cleaner.whatsAppSelectionNote: Select by my rules ticks only confirmed files of the chosen types that are older than the limit.
win.cleaner.emptyBinMessage: The Recycle Bin is emptied first, permanently. The other selected items then go to the Recycle Bin.
win.cleaner.whatsAppConfirmTitle: Move these files to the Recycle Bin?
win.cleaner.whatsAppConfirmNameOnlyForma: %d of them are recognized only by their names. Check that they really came from WhatsApp.
